passages.text: Quantization in edge computing reduces the bit-width of neural network weights from FP16 or FP32 to INT8 or INT4, significantly lowering memory bandwidth and power consumption while preserving task accuracy.
The GGUF container format replaced GGML in llama.cpp, providing extensible key-value metadata, rapid memory-mapped IO (mmap), and native support for modern architectures like LLaMA 3 and Qwen.
Linux Pressure Stall Information (PSI) exposes kernel-level metrics in /proc/pressure/memory and /proc/pressure/cpu indicating stall time caused by resource contention and page swapping.
The MediaTek Dimensity 920 is a 6nm mobile system-on-chip featuring 2 ARM Cortex-A78 performance cores at 2.5 GHz and 6 Cortex-A55 efficiency cores at 2.0 GHz.
Ollama implements prompt prefix caching by retaining KV cache states in GPU VRAM across consecutive inference calls with identical prefixes, resulting in near-zero prompt evaluation latency.
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 Mobile features the TU117 Turing GPU die fabricated on TSMC 12nm, featuring 896 CUDA cores and 4 GB of GDDR6 memory across a 128-bit memory bus.
Thermal throttling on Android occurs when CPU temperature sensors cross thermal zone thresholds, causing governor frequency steps to scale down clock rates to prevent overheating.
Time to First Token (TTFT) measures the total duration between client HTTP request dispatch and receipt of the first generated token chunk, including socket latency and prefill.
Vector embeddings represent text passages as dense high-dimensional vectors, enabling semantic retrieval via cosine similarity or inner product search.
Small Language Models (SLMs) under 3 billion parameters excel at structured extraction and localized tasks, but exhibit reasoning deficits in embodied sequential planning.
ARM NEON is a 128-bit SIMD architecture extension designed to accelerate signal processing and integer matrix multiplication on mobile processors.
Pydantic v2 utilizes Rust core parsing (pydantic-core) for strict JSON validation, schema serialization, and type enforcement in Python applications.
Wilson score confidence intervals provide conservative statistical boundaries for binomial proportion success rates, preventing over-claiming from small sample benchmarks.
Tailscale creates an authenticated WireGuard mesh VPN allowing direct peer-to-peer communication across NAT boundaries without public port forwarding.
Battery discharge percentage under sustained compute load reflects chemical battery degradation rather than direct milliwatt power consumption measurements.
